interpretation: Call this native-adapter distillation/retention regularization, not Nested Learning, Agent-Dice, or a LoRAGen reproduction.

Old behavioral questions remain excluded from training. Previously inspected old questions and existing ABC panels make this an exploratory comparison.
Joint acquisition/retention qualification and protected-minus-control behavioral gain are separately reported; no significance or replication claim.
